summary: Build SLA, RFP, and vendor governance skills in 5 days. Learn practical tools to control service providers and reduce third-party risk.
lede: IT vendor and service provider management helps you connect service-level governance, supplier evaluation, contract control, performance monitoring, third-party risk awareness, and escalation management to daily vendor work. Using structured methods such as ITIL 4 practices, COBIT, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls, you can manage providers with clearer evidence and more consistent oversight. The course gives you practical tools for evaluating RFPs, defining SLA and KPI structures, mapping service provider risks, creating vendor scorecards, and planning corrective action for underperformance. It also covers contract governance, business continuity considerations, and AI-supported dashboard reporting at an operational level, helping you balance cost, resilience, cybersecurity, and stakeholder expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage IT suppliers, oversee service performance, or support third-party governance in operational environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of IT operations, procurement, or service delivery processes. Familiarity with contracts, SLA tracking, and basic vendor reporting is helpful, but no coding is required. Advanced topics such as dashboard design, automated KPI tracking, and third-party risk analysis are taught at an operational application level, with practical examples and templates rather than implementation engineering.
